dedupe_keys.name: victorian traffic signals inventory of 5 066 operational traffic signal sites with type and coordinates

description: An open asset list of operational traffic signals in the Australian state of Victoria. Contents: the portal describes a standardised set of descriptive, administrative and classification data giving an overview of all Victorian operational traffic signal assets, including identifiers, type data and locations. The CSV read on 29 September 2026 had 5,066 rows with site number, site name (road pair), site type, municipality code, latitude and longitude; types were intersection signals (3,404), pedestrian-operated signals (1,399) and flashing pedestrian crossings (263). The OpenStreetMap wiki describes the department's earlier traffic lights dataset as the source of a MapRoulette import of missing signals and notes that the site number is the reference shown on the signal box. Producer: Department of Transport and Planning, Victoria. Coverage: the state of Victoria. Format and access: one CSV download from the Victorian transport open data portal; free. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Caveats: point locations only, with no phasing; the wiki links the older dataset to a different portal page that now holds a City of Ballarat list, so this current department dataset is used here; last modified August 2026. Simulation uses: siting signalised junctions and crossings in road network and traffic microsimulation models. Related records: the companion Traffic Signal Configuration Data Sheets dataset on the same portal holds phasing sheets per site.
